FEDIAF2025.basis: Species/life-stage reference intake; wet-food taurine is not a home-cooking retention coefficient.

AAHA_PAIN2022.basis: Canine OA omega-3 evidence differs from other nutraceuticals.

OA_META2022.document: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Enriched Therapeutic Diets and Nutraceuticals in Canine and Feline Osteoarthritis
OA_META2022.basis: Canine omega-3 clinical outcomes; very few feline studies; glucosamine/chondroitin lacks meaningful efficacy.

IRIS_DOG2026.basis: Stage, phosphate and electrolyte monitoring. Cat potassium intervention requires hypokalemia; no generic vitamin D or isolated omega-3 target inferred.

IRIS_CAT2026.basis: Stage, phosphate and electrolyte monitoring. Cat potassium intervention requires hypokalemia; no generic vitamin D or isolated omega-3 target inferred.

IRIS_RENAL_DIET.document: Diets for cats with chronic kidney disease
IRIS_RENAL_DIET.basis: Renal diet is a multicomponent intervention, not proof of isolated omega-3 benefit.

IRIS_HYPERCALCEMIA.basis: Calcitriol is distinct from nutritional vitamin D; cat calcitriol not routinely recommended. Article date unconfirmed.

ACVIM_MMVD2019.document: Diagnosis and treatment of myxomatous mitral valve disease in dogs
ACVIM_MMVD2019.basis: Stage C nutritional support; not all cardiac disease.

DCM_KAPLAN2018.document: Taurine deficiency and dilated cardiomyopathy in golden retrievers fed commercial diets
DCM_KAPLAN2018.basis: Observational deficient dogs, combined diet and supplementation; not breed prevention or isolated carnitine efficacy.

ACVIM_CIE2026.document: Consensus statement on diagnosis and management of chronic inflammatory enteropathy in dogs
ACVIM_CIE2026.basis: Treat suboptimal cobalamin status; route/course and follow-up are clinical decisions. Strain-specific probiotic evidence cannot support generic products.

MERCK_EPI2026.basis: EPI enzyme therapy and nutrition; cobalamin status and absorption, not diarrhea alone.

MERCK_PANC2025.basis: Enteral nutrition/tolerance; canine fat strategy not blindly transferred to cats.

CDS_DIET2018.document: Efficacy of a Therapeutic Diet on Dogs With Signs of Cognitive Dysfunction Syndrome
CDS_DIET2018.basis: MCT plus nutrient blend complete diets; cannot infer pure MCT supplement dose.

AAHA_SENIOR2023.basis: Cognitive status and individual nutrition, not universal senior supplement pack.

ICADA2015.document: Treatment of canine atopic dermatitis: updated guidelines
ICADA2015.basis: Possible limited chronic EFA benefit, no acute or universal allergy supplement. ICADA publication index checked 2026-09-22.

ACVIM_LIVER2019.document: Diagnosis and treatment of chronic hepatitis in dogs
ACVIM_LIVER2019.basis: Copper restriction for copper-associated disease; adjuncts and zinc require disease-specific clinical plans, monitoring and interaction review.

ACVIM_UROLITH2016.document: Treatment and prevention of uroliths in dogs and cats
ACVIM_UROLITH2016.basis: Stone-specific urine chemistry; avoid opposing acidification/alkalinization and unknown-stone empiricism.

AAHA_DM_DOG2026.document: Diabetes Management Guidelines: Dietary Management in Dogs
AAHA_DM_DOG2026.basis: Body condition, consistent intake, comorbid priorities; no glucose-lowering supplement substitute.

AAHA_DM_CAT2026.document: Diabetes Management Guidelines: Dietary Management in Cats
AAHA_DM_CAT2026.basis: Consistent nutrition, feline carbohydrate/protein strategy, medication-compatible meals.

AAHA_NUTRITION2021.basis: Energy and nutrient density with serial body-condition monitoring.

AAFP_FEEDING2018.document: How to Feed a Cat Consensus Statement
AAFP_FEEDING2018.basis: Frequent small meals; exact household meal count is an implementation choice, not a validated clinical dose.
